officialOwnershipEvidence.evidenceTitle: UPSC Civil Services Examination Rules - Inclusion of DANICS/DANIPS
officialOwnershipEvidence.verifiedFact: Delhi, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep, Daman & Diu and Dadra & Nagar Haveli Civil Service (DANICS) and Police Service (DANIPS) Group B services are recruited through UPSC Civil Services Examination.

overlapRows.architecturalNotes: Union Territories do not conduct independent State Civil Service examinations for DANICS/DANIPS. Canonical mission is upsc_cse_prelims; regional entries in DL, AN, LD, DN provide discovery pointers only.

officialOwnershipEvidence.evidenceTitle: SSC Notice - Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Examination

overlapRows.architecturalNotes: Deconstructed from 47A3 compound candidate. Canonical mission is ssc_cpo owned by auth_in_ssc. Delhi region provides discoverability pointer; duplicate Delhi SI mission is suppressed from materialization.

officialOwnershipEvidence.evidenceTitle: SSC Notice - Constable (Executive) Male and Female in Delhi Police Examination

officialOwnershipEvidence.evidenceTitle: SSC Notice - Selection Posts for UT of Ladakh

overlapRows.architecturalNotes: Canonical exam owner is auth_in_ssc; client/beneficiary UT is Administration of UT of Ladakh (auth_in_la_admin). Regional discoverability is LA.

officialOwnershipEvidence.verifiedFact: CBSE CTET qualifies candidates for teaching appointments in schools of UTs (Chandigarh, Dadra & Nagar Haveli, Daman & Diu, Andaman & Nicobar, Lakshadweep, Delhi) and states lacking independent state TET (e.g. Goa).
